adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a legitimate architectural concern in the new webhook endpoint. Looking at lines 68-91 in app-credential.ts, the code does a simple findFirst/update or create pattern without any timestamp, version, or idempotency check. If webhooks arrive out of order or are replayed, newer credentials could be overwritten by older ones. This is a valid design concern for the new credential sync feature, though it's more of a missing safeguard than a definite bug - it depends on the external system's behavior and whether replay/ordering issues actually occur in practice.
